llm_response.reason: The website mimics SCHIESSER, a well-known clothing brand, but operates on the unrelated 'maryferguson.shop' domain and not the official company URL. There are multiple problematic signals: (1) no visible company address or verifiable business info on the contact or privacy pages, just an anonymous web form; (2) privacy policy lacks required legal identity statements and is vague; (3) repeated use of trust-assuring language, e.g., '100% Sicher shoppen', with no substantiation; (4) likely spoofing of branding. These are all classic scam website patterns, specifically of fake online shops.
